Genetics, bionics or artificial intelligence, what will the future be made of?
It will be made out of stupid people abusing technology for their personal gain and Luddites trying to push us back into the caves.

These three options (bionic, genetic, & non-organic) could be seen as mutually exclusive—forces acting against each other, with the winner determining what the future will look like. In reality, I would argue that all three are components of a larger, cohesive narrative, one that has humans soaring high above all other life, breaking free from the shackles of natural evolution, colonising the solar system and why not the universe too, while we’re at it.

Fuck yes, this is how I want more people to think – on the scale of motherfucking humanity.

However, further into the future, genetics (with the help of synthetic biology) will allow us to develop organic bionics: seamless interfaces between the living and the artificial—where the very distinction between the two starts breaking down.

This is a fascinating possibility, getting to the point where you can't tell the difference between a naturally grown limb and an artificial one, what does artificial even mean anymore in that context?
